input: Brainstorm a plot for a haiku about a whale and a walnut tree.
text:
A whale once swam in the vast ocean,
Seeking solace from the deep blue.
In the midst of waves, it found a walnut tree.

The whale marveled at its towering height,
Its branches reaching for the sky.
A rare sight in the depths of the sea.

One day, as the whale swam by,
It heard a faint rustling sound.
A walnut fell from the tree and landed on the shore.

The whale was curious and swam to the shore,
It nudged the walnut with its snout.
The walnut rolled and rolled, until it stopped at its feet.

The whale was intrigued, it picked up the walnut,
And carried it back to the ocean.
It placed it on the ocean floor, where it could be seen.

The walnut tree stood tall and proud,
As the whale swam away, with a new friend in tow.
A tale of two unlikely friends, forever etched in time.

The walnut tree and the whale,
A bond forged by fate, in the depths of the sea.
A haiku of friendship, that will never fade away.
